clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 5/Sec 2) specifies requirements for recessed luminaires for use with tungsten filament, tubular fluorescent, LED, LED modules and other discharge lamps on supply voltage not exceeding 1 000 V. This standard does not cover air-handing luminaires. This standard does not apply to air-handling or liquid-cooled luminaires. It is to be read in conjunction with those Sections of Part 1 to which reference is made.
